headlines.description: Arsenal opened their bid to defend the Premier League title with a comfortable 3-0 victory over Coventry City at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal ease past Coventry to start new Prem season

headlines.description: Manchester United made a nightmare start to the new season as promoted Hull confounded their many doubters by securing a shock 2-0 victory on their Premier League return.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man United slip to surprise Hull PL defeat

headlines.description: Thierno Barry scored in Everton's comfortable 2-0 Premier League victory over Crystal Palace to give manager David Moyes one less thing to worry about -- for now.
headlines.shortLinkText: Everton beat Palace 2-0 to open season as PM watches

headlines.description: Jack Clarke fired newly-promoted Ipswich to an opening-day victory with a 90th-minute winner to down old club Sunderland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ipswich mark PL return with late win over Sunderland

headlines.description: Anton Stach's late free kick saw Leeds kick off their Premier League campaign with a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Stach free kick helps Leeds beat Forest

headlines.description: Tottenham's expensive summer rebuild was shaken to its foundations by rampant Brentford on an alarming opening day for Roberto De Zerbi's side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tottenham thumped by Brentford in PL opener

events.name: Aston Villa at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Jack Hinshelwood struck twice in two first-half minutes as rampant Brighton ruthlessly exploited Aston Villa's summer exodus with a thumping 4-0 Premier League victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brilliant Brighton batter dreadful Aston Villa

headlines.description: Manchester City produced a dramatic late fightback to snatch a 2-1 victory over Bournemouth in Enzo Maresca's first Premier League match as their manager.
headlines.shortLinkText: City strike late to break Bournemouth's hearts

headlines.description: Dominik Szoboszlai converted a stoppage-time penalty to snatch a draw as Newcastle and Liverpool served up a Premier League thriller of which Kevin Keegan would have been proud.
headlines.shortLinkText: Last-gasp Liverpool claim draw at Newcastle

headlines.description: Xabi Alonso made a winning start to life as Chelsea manager in a chaotic 3-2 win over Fulham at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea edge Fulham, Alonso off to winning start
